broadcasts.name: September Product Update
broadcasts.subject: Introducing Relaybase Scale v2.0
broadcasts.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

We just shipped **Relaybase Scale v2.0** — the first version built for teams who send product email from their own domain, not a shared marketing subdomain.

### What is new

- **Broadcast stats** — delivery, opens, clicks, and unsubscribes roll up per send without leaving the dashboard.
- **Audience groups** — link a list once; recipients are resolved at send time so late subscribers still receive scheduled mail.
- **Compliance footers** — CAN-SPAM blocks pull from a reusable sender identity instead of one-off copy/paste.

### Why it matters

If you have been stitching together spreadsheets, BCC tests, and manual unsubscribe replies, this release is meant to replace that loop with something you can audit.

[Read the full launch notes](https://relaybase.com/blog/v2)

Thanks for reading,
The Relaybase team

[July changelog](https://relaybase.com/changelog)

[Launch notes](https://relaybase.com/blog/v2) · [Watch the 8-minute demo](https://relaybase.com/demo)

If you hit a blocker, reply to this thread — we are actively pairing with design partners.

broadcasts.previewText: A short security note for accounts using Scale send keys
broadcasts.name: Mid-August Security Note
broadcasts.subject: Rotate your domain-scoped API keys
broadcasts.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

We are asking all early Scale testers to **rotate domain-scoped API keys** this week.

**Why now**

- Scale stores a send key to call `POST /v1/send` on your Worker.
- Keys issued before August may have been copied into local dev stores or shared in screenshots.

**What to do**

1. Console → **API Keys** → revoke the old `CRM Broadcast` key if present.
2. Send a test mail from Scale — the app will issue a fresh key automatically.
3. Confirm the `from` address matches the key domain (`@relaybase.xyz`).

This takes about two minutes and prevents stale credentials from lingering in JSON fixtures.

Stay safe,
Relaybase Security

Welcome, {{contact.name}} —

You are on **Product Updates**, our low-frequency list for release notes, beta invites, and occasional roadmap context. We typically send **once or twice a month**, never daily blasts.

**What you will get**

- Shipped features with enough detail to decide whether to turn them on.
- Links to docs — not vague marketing fluff.
- Clear unsubscribe on every message (one click, no login).

**What you will not get**

- Re-forwarded newsletters from other tools.
- Purchased lists or “growth hack” sequences.

While you are here, skim the [getting started guide](https://relaybase.com/docs/start) if you have not connected a domain yet.

Glad you are along for the ride,
Product team @ Relaybase

broadcasts.previewText: Five steps before your first real broadcast
broadcasts.name: Product Launch Wave
broadcasts.subject: Wave 2 — onboarding checklist
broadcasts.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

You are in **Wave 2** of the Scale beta. Before you press **Send Now**, walk through this checklist:

1. **Verify domain** — Console shows `ready` for `relaybase.xyz`.
2. **Create a sender** — pick `hello@` or `jon@` on that domain.
3. **Compliance sender** — organization name + postal address filled in.
4. **Audience** — at least one active contact (your test inbox counts).
5. **Test send** — Publish tab → send to yourself; confirm HTML + footer.

[Open the onboarding checklist](https://relaybase.com/start)

Once green, duplicate this broadcast and send to the full Product Updates group.

Thanks for helping us harden the pipeline,
Customer success

broadcasts.previewText: How we want feedback during the Scale send beta
broadcasts.name: Partner note
broadcasts.subject: A note for design partners
broadcasts.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

Thank you for being a **design partner** on Relaybase Scale. This note sets expectations for the next two weeks of testing.

**We need from you**

- One **test send** and one **small real send** (≤10 recipients) with notes on anything confusing.
- Screenshots or Loom if the UI blocks you — especially Publish and Stats tabs.
- Honest feedback on copy, footers, and unsubscribe flow.

**We owe you**

- Same-day replies on blocking bugs during business hours (UTC+7).
- A written changelog when we flip List-Unsubscribe headers on the Worker.

No NDA beyond what you already agreed — feel free to talk about the experience, not other customers’ data.

Gratefully,
Isaac

Engineering Weekly editors
